name: scaffold-hbar-ferry402
description: A paid HTTP API starter: charge per call in USDC on Base, settle into a non-custodial escrow, and journal every payment to Hedera Consensus Service. Built on @ferry402/sdk and @ferry402/facilitator.

instructions: Copy packages/api/.env.example to packages/api/.env and fill in FACILITATOR_PRIVATE_KEY, PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY, HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID, HEDERA_PRIVATE_KEY and FERRY402_SECRET -- see README.md "Environment variables" for how to get each.
Run `npm run dev` -- this launches the merchant API and the facilitator together on http://localhost:3001.
In another terminal, run `npm run next:dev` and open http://localhost:3000 -- the dashboard shows the live 402 bill, the Escrow ledger balance, and the HCS journal reconciled against Base Sepolia.
Run `npm run pay` to make a real payment end to end: it signs an EIP-3009 authorization, settles it into the Escrow contract on Base Sepolia, and journals the payment to Hedera Consensus Service.
Run `npm run foundry:test` for the Escrow contract's unit, invariant and golden-vector suites.
Read README.md for the full walkthrough, live example transactions, and honest limitations before using this for anything beyond testnet.
